subject: design/feature-implementation-drive
statement: Feature tasks are routable only through projections derived from the current aggregate. On each frontier reconciliation, the drive computes `ready = open ∧ all blockers RecordLanding-complete ∧ no open proposal ∧ no active claim`, then projects routing only for those task ids to the current owner domain. Local ownership projects the registered machine's routing signal; remote ownership projects the configured remote-domain signal. An unowned, quiescing, cancelled, abandoned, delivered, or blocked drive projects none.
